name: offline-ml-semester-projects
description: One-command launcher for CrisisLens and LeafGuard offline ML semester projects.

scripts.build:ui: npm --prefix crisislens/ui run build && npm --prefix leafguard/ui run build
scripts.verify: npm run train && npm run test && npm run build:ui && .venv/bin/python -m compileall -q crisislens leafguard scripts
